sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Syncs data with the Baby Tracker server.

force_resync.name: Force Resync
force_resync.description: Deletes the local copy of the data and downloads everything from the Baby Tracker server again. Use it when the sync group was reset in the app. Records that were never uploaded are uploaded first; if that fails, nothing is deleted.
